exercise.name: Dumbbell Clean and Press

reference.title: Dumbbell Clean and Press
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Weightlifting, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

exercise.type: Power and strength (clean plus overhead press)
exercise.mechanics: Compound (hang clean: explosive triple extension, pull and catch; then a strict overhead press)

breathing.pattern: Brace for the clean, breathe out standing with the dumbbells racked; breathe in, brace and press, breathe out at the top or on the way down.
breathing.cadence: Fast clean (about 0.5 s from the hang to the catch), about 0.9 s press, 1.1 s lowering

prescription.tempo: Explosive clean, controlled press and lowering
prescription.load: User-chosen dumbbells; the press usually limits the load. Stop about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2).
prescription.progression: Add load, or clean from the floor (power clean) before the press

cues.text: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
Hinge to the hang: dumbbells just above the knees, flat back.
Jump through the floor, shrug, pull the elbows high and out.
Turn the elbows forward and catch on the shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, dumbbells on the shoulders.
Press straight up until the arms are straight beside the ears.
Hold the lockout, dumbbells over the shoulders.
Lower under control back to the shoulders.
Pause with the dumbbells on the shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides.

mistakes.fix: Squeeze the glutes and keep the ribs down; use lighter dumbbells.

mistakes.mistake: Pulling with the arms early in the clean
mistakes.fix: Let the hips and legs finish the extension first.
Press straight up so the dumbbells finish over the shoulders.
Absorb the catch in a quarter squat.

kinematics.norm: Quarter squat, upright trunk, elbows forward (NSCA Essentials)

kinematics.setup: Upper arm ≈25° from the trunk in the rack
kinematics.peak: ≈171° overhead, elbows ≈4° (nearly straight), dumbbells over the shoulders
kinematics.norm: Arms straight overhead with the dumbbells over the shoulders, trunk upright (clinical opinion)

kinematics.setup: Clean: 0.7 s hinge, explosive 0.5 s pull and catch
kinematics.peak: Press 0.9 s up, 0.4 s lockout, 1.1 s down to the shoulders, 1.15 s back to the sides
kinematics.norm: Explosive clean (NSCA Essentials); controlled press and lowering (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #340012, Dumbbell Clean and Press, video (movement reference)

Caulfield, Hornsby & Haff, power exercises: power clean (and hang power clean variation), excerpt from NSCA Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning, 5th edition (Haff & Triplett, eds.; Human Kinetics)
Suchomel, Wright, Kernozek & Kline 2014, kinetic comparison of the power development between power clean variations (J Strength Cond Res 28(2):350-360)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
The dumbbell load is your choice: pick a weight you can move with the form shown for every rep.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Fast lifts: learn the positions slowly with a light dumbbell first, keep the dumbbells close to the body and clear a space around you.
Shoulder pain overhead: press only through a pain-free range or keep to the clean.
modify: Limited overhead mobility: press with the palms facing in (as shown) and stop short of full lockout.
Low-back pain: keep the hang short; skip the lift if pain persists.
regressions: Standing or seated dumbbell shoulder press.
progressions: Dumbbell power clean and press from the floor.
Dumbbell push press or split jerk for heavier loads.

muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Drive the explosive hip extension of the second pull, then help absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Drive the explosive hip extension of the second pull, then help absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.quads_r: Extend the knees in the drive and absorb the dumbbells in the quarter-squat catch.
muscleNotes.quads_l: Extend the knees in the drive and absorb the dumbbells in the quarter-squat catch.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Hold the hinge at the hang and extend the hips with the glutes.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Hold the hinge at the hang and extend the hips with the glutes.
muscleNotes.calves_r: Rise onto the balls of the feet at the top of the extension (the heels may lift, NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.calves_l: Rise onto the balls of the feet at the top of the extension (the heels may lift, NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Shrug at the end of the pull and help rotate the shoulder blades up overhead.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Shrug at the end of the pull and help rotate the shoulder blades up overhead.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Lift the elbows in the pull and help press overhead.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Lift the elbows in the pull and help press overhead.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Turn the elbows forward into the rack, then press the dumbbells overhead.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Turn the elbows forward into the rack, then press the dumbbells overhead.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells are pulled up and turned over; control the lowering.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells are pulled up and turned over; control the lowering.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Grip the handles through the pull and the catch.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Grip the handles through the pull and the catch.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold a flat back at the hang and through the drive.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold a flat back at the hang and through the drive.
muscleNotes.core: Brace the trunk; do not lean back to press.
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Straighten the elbows to finish the press.
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Straighten the elbows to finish the press.
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Rotates the shoulder blades upward so the arms can reach overhead.
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Rotates the shoulder blades upward so the arms can reach overhead.
